metadata.description: Fabrizio Duroni's Claude Code plugins: Public Plugins for any repository, and the Project Plugins that build Chicio Labs itself

plugins.name: glossary-browser
plugins.description: Public Plugin. Browse a repository's ubiquitous language (GLOSSARY-MAP.md, each context's GLOSSARY.md, the ADRs) in a band above the prompt and a pane, and steer you and the model away from its Avoid words: a note to the model on prompts, a refusal on Markdown edits

plugins.name: image-peek
plugins.description: Public Plugin, macOS. See the images you paste into Claude Code: a thumbnail above the prompt for each [Image #N], drawn in any truecolor terminal (Warp included) and with real pixels in kitty and Ghostty, and a button that opens it full size in Quick Look

plugins.name: chicio-labs-sdlc
plugins.description: Project Plugin, Chicio Labs only. The agentic SDLC pipeline (explore, Human Gate, parallel Work Units, reviews, PR) and the release checklist

plugins.name: website-content
plugins.description: Project Plugin, Chicio Labs only. Write Posts in Fabrizio Duroni's voice and add Manga and Games to the collections
